title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: EDHOC test vectors need independent cross-validation
description: The Rust EDHOC test vectors in 'rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors()' (`rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:1575-1670`) were updated with new expected values (th_2, prk_2e, keystream_2, th_3, th_4, prk_out, prk_exporter, exporter secrets). However, these vectors cannot have been cross-validated against the Python simulator because the Python implementation hasn't been updated yet. Test vectors must be validated against an independent implementation (per project policy: 'Never derive test vectors from the code under test'). Fix: after updating the Python simulator to match, regenerate test vectors and verify both implementations produce identical output. Consider also validating against the published RFC 9528 test vectors if available.
